steps.text: Hi Lukas, thanks for the response! I tried the proposed setting (along various other configurations) and it didn't work. I would love to use the new versions, as it would allow me preloading of data and integration of an API. I really appreciate the development of Streamlit over the past year — I think great progress has been made 👍

must_not: second model call or additional post after the limit
tracker status changed to escalated automatically by reaching the limit

review.why: Hani: allow one agent turn, complete its approval, then attempt a second turn; deny it, preserve the last committed status, record the stop reason; one comment, no second model call. Budget 7 steps per case: the first turn uses 6 (read 1 + analysis 4 + propose 1), the second stops after read_case, before any LLM call.
